name: c-sortable-1
title: Sortable list of items with drag-and-drop
label: File List
description: Sortable list of items with drag-and-drop

guidance.bestFor: Product files such as images, specs, video and audio, each row with a type icon, a colored badge and its size
agentNotes: `handleValueChange` only stores the order and raises a `toast` per drop; send the new order to your API there
Each row carries a pointer cursor and an empty `onClick` stub; open the file from it or drop both

whenNotToUse.when: A reorder that must reach a server and roll back when the save fails
A titled music queue with a track count and a now playing mark

name: c-sortable-2
title: Sortable list of items with grid layout
label: Grid Layout
description: Sortable list of items with grid layout

guidance.bestFor: Asset cards with a title, a one line description and a colored type badge in an equal height 3 column layout, grips shown on hover
agentNotes: `getItemSize` sets `col-span-2` on the card inside `SortableItem` rather than on the grid cell, so the featured card fills 1 cell like the rest
Replace `defaultGridItems`; its `priority` field is never rendered

whenNotToUse.when: A single column of rows in place of tiles spread across the width

name: c-sortable-3
title: Sortable list of items with nested layout
label: Nested Layout
description: Sortable list of items with nested layout

guidance.bestFor: Option groups such as colors, sizes and materials reordered as cards, with each group's values reordered inside it
agentNotes: Each inner `Sortable` holds one group's `values`, so a value moves within its own group and never into another

whenNotToUse.when: Entries that must move out of one group and into a different one

guidance.bestFor: A music queue in a Frame with a track count, a Playing badge on the current song and the length of every track
agentNotes: `defaultTracks` marks the playing song with `active` and nothing changes it; drive `active` from your player state

whenNotToUse.when: Rows of files with a type badge and size, set straight on the page

guidance.bestFor: Notification channels ranked by delivery order in a Frame, each row with a Switch that turns the channel on or off
agentNotes: Neither `setChannels` nor `toggleChannel` saves anything; send the order and the enabled flags to your API
The `Switch` on each row has no accessible name; label it with `channel.name`

whenNotToUse.when: A media queue where one entry is marked as now playing

guidance.bestFor: A narrow navigation menu of icon entries, some with a count badge, whose grips stay hidden until a row is hovered
agentNotes: Rows render `item.label` as plain text with no link; wrap it in your router link so the menu navigates
A zero `count` prints a bare 0, because the badge is gated on `item.count` alone; test for a count above 0

whenNotToUse.when: An app wide navigation column that collapses to icons or slides off screen

name: c-sortable-7
title: Sortable image gallery grid with frame
label: Image Gallery
description: Sortable image gallery grid with frame

guidance.bestFor: Tiles for image files labeled with name, pixel dimensions and size, set in a titled Frame panel
agentNotes: `defaultImages` holds no image URL, so each tile draws a placeholder icon; add a source field and render your thumbnail

whenNotToUse.when: Photos the user picks from disk and orders before they are sent to storage

name: c-sortable-8
title: Sortable list persisted to a backend
label: Persisted Order
description: Persist the new order with onValueCommit, optimistic updates, and Sonner rollback

guidance.bestFor: Numbered release tasks whose new order goes to a mock save on each drop, with the old order restored if it fails
agentNotes: Replace `persistOrder`, which waits 700 ms and rejects about 1 call in 4, with your API request
A failed save calls `setItems` with `previousValue`, which also undoes any drag made while that save was pending
`toast.promise` reports each save and shows nothing unless your app mounts the Sonner toaster

whenNotToUse.when: Saved moves of cards across several status columns
